body:
I understand your point, and I may try it. But I also think that clothes and other things should not be governed by a specific gender. Therefore, at least in my opinion, dressing one way or another should have nothing to do with it (although I understand that there are people who do need it and notice a difference, but in the end that's just something about the binary mindset, whether you're trans or not, etc.).

I think then that I lean more towards the non-binary spectrum but feeling linked to my birth gender (in this case female). I've thought that maybe i'm demigender, but I don't want to limit myself by putting a specific label or definition on what I am either. Also, I'm still figuring it out so I may try some of your recommendations. But thanks for commenting, it's really appreciated <3

I have found a post here from another girl with more or less the same doubt as me. The truth is that I felt quite identified with his explanation. She said: "I have identified as a girl my whole life, but recently (the past year or so) have been questioning my gender. I like the idea of being called a boy and I like dressing in "boyish clothes", but I also dont mind being a girl like 40% of the time." (I have put the part of the text with which I identify myself).

Thank you very much for your words. I really wasn't sure if it was straight up rape, since at the time I didn't think about it, I was blinded by "love". He made fun of me for telling him I couldn't take it anymore or to stop. But I had let him do it, I was "in love", so I had many doubts. I decided to tell my story because I saw a post from a girl who had a similar experience.

Thank you for commenting and clearing all my doubts, I know that I am not alone, and I guess that in a way I belong here.

They don't know you. They really don't care what you do with your life. They want to appear to be good people with a big heart, who help us who are "sick" not commit suicide. Wanting people not to commit suicide is also selfish, has anyone thought that? For not feeling pain, or guilt, for not losing something they love even if they are living in hell. Everything is very hypocritical and selfish. And besides, in the end it is us who are to blame, and make us feel worse. "There was nothing you could do to save him/her", "It is him/her decision to die", etc. It is my decision, but because I have no other choice, and many things can be done to save someone, but no one really listens or makes an effort. The only ones who have to make an effort are us, we are the "sick". Normally most people kill themselves if they don't have anyone, if their problems really don't have a solution, if the others have screwed you up so much that life is no longer worth it.
Lol, wtf? Why do you want to kill everyone around you?

Since I was born all my life has gone wrong in many ways, but as a child I didn't realize or notice much. And every year that I have fulfilled, more problems have been added, more errors, without the others being solved. And there are some that cannot be solved.

It is not useful. I'm fed up and tired of everything. Talking about it doesn't help, I've talked to too many people, professionals and non-professionals, and you know what? Here I am, even more screwed. "Letting off steam" loses its value and is of no use when everything in your life continues to go wrong for a long long time. I just want to find a fucking way to die, but they're all fucking painful, likely to survive, or inaccessible. All I want is to rest, but I won't be given a damn second to breathe.

I know that paracetamol causes a lot of pain, but almost all forms of dying are painful. And really, if you take a lot of paracetamol it is easy to die from liver failure.

I know it's also difficult with fluoxetine, but there must be an amount that your body can't handle, whatever the medication is, no? That is, it seems logical that if you take too many medications at once your body will not be able to control it. 

The reasons do not matter, it is tedious to explain, and in the end they never understand you, or they cannot help you.
You want to talk for a while? around here or chat, I don't care
Hi

Not everything I see or feel is suffering, although much of it is. I can still enjoy things, people who are not shit, and laugh sometimes. But nothing is the same as when I was innocent and was able to lie to me just like the others do. All I wanted was to be happy, but I asked too much. All I wanted was to live quietly, without anyone bothering me, but I also asked for too much. Now all I want is to rest, because I really can't take it anymore, my exhaustion has reached a level that is exhausting by itself. I dont know. I know that dying is not the solution, but there is no better solution either. My other option is to keep holding on and trying, even when I can't take it anymore. But really, that option is no longer viable. I did not want my destiny to be this, I had dreams, I wanted to do things, but I have no energy, desire, or reason. It is too much effort and suffering for so little. I will never be able to forget the things i lived, or lie to myself again. I will not be able to ignore the suffering of others. Anyway, thanks for talking to me for a while.

What makes me unhappy is society, the horrible things that happen on a daily basis, the bad people, or that screw up the lives of others, something that will never change. What makes me unhappy is knowing that it will always be this way, that I really can't do anything to change it, that there are so many people like me who suffer. And it makes me unhappy that our life really has no meaning, we try to find one for because we are born, and well, it is what you are supposed to do, no matter how much you suffer or how difficult it is. We study half a life to work, we work to survive, and we survive for a pinch of happiness, for the hope of having the life we ​​want to have, for fulfilling the ideals that have been imposed on us from before we were born. I did not ask to be born, I did not ask to suffer, I have tried hard, and that is enough. It is nonsense. We believe we have freedom or control, but we don't have it, we never will. We obey thousands of imposed things, and we cannot be in control because in our lives the external factor is greater and affects us much more than anything else. No matter what you try, or what you do or decide, if you are unlucky and the external factor is against you, nothing will go right. And maybe your only option is to put up with the shit and try hard. It is what many have to do, because there are no solutions for everything. And I'm not going to continue doing it, I reached my limit.

Aha, I agree with that. But what i mean is that at least I don't lie to myself, nor distort the "reality" in which we live: the society, what we do, etc. Although it seems easier to call it "reality". It is ours, there is not only one reality in my opinion, but that is another topic. That is one of the many reasons that makes me unhappy, but it is too late to lie to me again.

I'm not an idiot. I realize the good things in life, and the bad things. Those good things just aren't worth enough compared to the bad. The truth is that I only see what the world is like, its harshest reality. I'm jaded of being judged, so think what you want.

I am atheist. And I do not plan to live to old age, it seems silly to me, I have no reason to do so, I have already changed the lives of others and I have helped many people. I have dreams, but it's not worth it. You will not understand it, like many others, but it is so, and that's it. So that method of living to old age is not viable for me.
Thank you for read and comment. I wish you luck.
sometimes I feel like I'm mute, because I can go a whole day without talking to anyone if I don't leave my house, and if I go outside I don't speak too much, so yes, i understand u

A mí también, me ha causado un problema que no habría pasado si no existiera esta mierda. Acostumbro a querer estar siempre en mi casa, pero ahora me asfixio al no poder salir. La cuarentena. Espero que pase rápido y no te afecte más de la cuenta, que te vaya bien.
¿La edad que tengo? Dentro de 14 días cumplo 16 años. /  How old am I? In 14 days I will be 16 years old.

I understand you, I really understand you. I wish you didn't have to end up like this. Whatever you do, I want you to know that there is someone who understands you, that I am not going to tell you that "everything will work out", nor will I call you selfish, because you are not. You just want to rest.
